words.definition: in a way that relates to the economy, or cost-effectively
words.example: The new process allows the factory to operate more economically.
words.exampleTranslation: 這套新流程讓工廠能更節約地運作。

words.definition: in a uniform or equal manner
words.example: Divide the workload evenly among all team members.
words.exampleTranslation: 把工作量平均分配給所有團隊成員。

words.definition: the quality of being outstanding
words.example: The award recognizes excellence in customer service.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個獎項表揚在客戶服務方面表現卓越的人。

words.definition: only, not including anything else
words.example: This offer is available exclusively to premium members.
words.exampleTranslation: 這項優惠僅限尊榮會員享有。

words.definition: an expression of good wishes when parting
words.example: The office held a farewell party for the retiring manager.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室為即將退休的經理舉辦了一場歡送會。

words.definition: extreme tiredness
words.example: Long shifts can lead to fatigue among warehouse staff.
words.exampleTranslation: 長時間輪班可能導致倉庫員工感到疲勞。

words.definition: relating to government revenue or financial matters
words.example: The company's fiscal year begins in April.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家公司的會計年度從四月開始。

words.definition: a group of vehicles operated together
words.example: The delivery company expanded its fleet of electric vans.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家快遞公司擴充了旗下的電動廂型車車隊。

words.definition: a powder made from ground grain, used in baking
words.example: The bakery orders flour in bulk from a local mill.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間麵包店向當地的磨坊大量訂購麵粉。

words.definition: a thick cloud of tiny water droplets near the ground
words.example: Dense fog caused several flight delays this morning.
words.exampleTranslation: 濃霧導致今天早上好幾班航班延誤。

words.definition: in an official or formal way
words.example: The merger was formally announced at the press conference.
words.exampleTranslation: 這次合併在記者會上正式宣布。

words.definition: a metric unit of mass
words.example: The recipe calls for two hundred grams of flour.
words.exampleTranslation: 這道食譜需要兩百公克的麵粉。

words.definition: a reference book giving instructions or information
words.example: New hires receive an employee handbook on their first day.
words.exampleTranslation: 新進員工在第一天會收到一本員工手冊。

words.definition: a device worn over the ears to listen to audio
words.example: Wear headphones so you don't disturb your coworkers.
words.exampleTranslation: 戴上耳機以免打擾到同事。

words.definition: a device that produces heat
words.example: The office installed a new heater for the winter.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室為了冬天安裝了新的暖氣機。

words.definition: a protective covering for the head
words.example: All construction workers must wear a helmet on site.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有工地工人都必須戴安全帽。

words.definition: a person who walks long distances for pleasure
words.example: The trail is popular among hikers on weekends.
words.exampleTranslation: 這條步道在週末很受健行者歡迎。

words.definition: without a home
words.example: The charity provides meals for homeless individuals downtown.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個慈善機構為市中心無家可歸的人提供餐點。

words.definition: a small device used to light fires or cigarettes
words.example: He looked for a lighter to light the candle at the reception.
words.exampleTranslation: 他在接待會上找打火機來點蠟燭。

words.definition: in a loud manner
words.example: Please don't speak loudly during the presentation.
words.exampleTranslation: 簡報期間請不要大聲說話。
